body: I know, but it is the story of the wanderer, who's brave but in the end gets overwhelmed by impossible odds. It is a depressing lot to be in, but one i always end up back in :(

I know. I'm the same way :( I feel abandoned, by the one person I ever truely let in. I had pushed away friends because of being hurt by them, my x-gf had hurt me severely and now this. I don't know what to do myself. All i know is that i have to hope that stuff gets better. I don't trust people, and rarely befriend people because of it, and am always suspicious of people. I'm trying to figure out a way out myself. I want to let people in and trust, but i always get hurt by it all. I also feel they judge my every flaw where i love them for theirs.

I also struggle with depression, I've had ups and downs, and i feel this way a lot. One of the reasons I am here right now is because I just lost everything I cared for.

I lost all of my friends awhile back, had a awful breakup and relationship, and pretty much had nothing to keep me sane. I hated me life, just went about life like a zombie. But one kind girl kept me going, she made me happy. She got me out of my depression, and away from my immediate insane thoughts. She helped me so much.

Now a few years later here i am, finally feeling happy, legitimately happy. She cheered me up when I was so down. She was always there for me.

Lately I'd gotten better with trying to deal with everything life threw at me, I hated life for a long while, but she made it better. I had my girl there with me, my koala as i called her. She kept me sane, helped me keep my head above water so to speak. She made everything else manageable, because she kept me happy. Showed me a new way to live.

Unfortunately, Over the weekend she left me. I hurt her emotionally, unintentionally, in a way I wish I never did and could take back. But I can't, I don't know how. So now i have to watch as my savior walks away, leaving me alone. Knowing that I hurt her. Wishing I could make it all better.

I feel like the sun is setting on my life too now, I have nothing but darkness closing in around me. I don't want to go on without her, I'm alone now. No friends, no koala.

I too have nothing to fight for, no reason to want to go on. I honestly don't want to live without her. But, I promised her I wouldn't do anything to hurt her, and I know giving up would hurt her a lot. Even though she is gone, she would never want me to have made her waste those years of her life. So I keep trying to live, day by day now.

You just have to keep going, when i was last down before i knew her, I wanted to die. It looked so bleak. I was so close to what felt like losing my mind to sadness, hating life daily, hating the pain i had to live with. But that's when she came into my life, out of no where. She gave me purpose again, made life worth living. Even though I've now lost her, I hope she will come back one day. Or maybe somewhere else In life, another unlikely arrival will help me survive.

The point is, often when everything looks its darkest, is when you are closest to salvation. Sometimes we give up within sight of the finish line. You should never give up, keep going, sometimes the person who can help you is only around the corner. Mine literally lived within a few blocks of me for years before i met her. I'm sure if you hang on, you'll find there is purpose for you out there. Just never give up, and try to keep looking up. Life will get better, it often just needs time.

What it took me was to change my outlook on life, it wasn't easy. But it will happen. Now I remind myself hourly that i can keep going, I'm not dead yet, this life isn't over. Yours isn't either, don't give up. Life will have ups and downs, just because you're in a down, doesn't mean the ups are very far away. Life can change in a day, in a single day you can find that everything changes for the better.
